BiblicalUsage: To beat, to pound, as the people ground the manna in mills and beat it in a mortar, then baked it into cakes that tasted like fresh oil.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God gave bread that needed beating, because daily bread is work as well as gift, and the manna never fell ready-baked.
RelatedEvents: Manna and Quail in the Wilderness
